answer: The basalt conduit carries every identity's echo, and each epoch any echo no client paid for grinds its wall a notch deeper, never healing. The mill patches notches with shale, billing each at the depth the conduit has reached when the epoch closes, so the operator's thousandth echo costs a thousand shale where its first cost one, and a thousand clones burn a million shale. Fresh wallets and new hosts grind the same wall; honest echoes are prepaid by clients.
